newsitem.title: USA: Mako Marine expects "going concern" report.
newsitem.headline: Mako Marine expects "going concern" report.

text.p: Mako Marine International Inc said Friday it expects independent auditors to include a "going concern" statement on their report for the company's 6 financial statement for fiscal 1996 ended June 29, primarily because of accumulated losses and negative cash flows.
The company said it is pursuing additional funding from a variety of sources.

The company said that it expected losses to continue at least through the end of the year, and that the losses are mainly because of excessive manufacturing costs, increased personnel costs and increased selling and marketing costs.
The company said it has begun efforts to eliminate losses and attain profitability, including streamlining its product line from 24 models to 18 in fiscal 1996 and down to 14 by year's end.
The company said it has also expanded its distribution network and plans to increase prices on its products despite refraining from price hikes in fiscal 1996.
Mako Marine International Inc designs, makes and sells offshore sports fishing, family recreational and commercial boats.
